summary: Dreamland Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq letter confirming the company regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement after its Class A ordinary shares closed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days through May 4, 2026. No transaction, strategic change, or special situation is involved; the filing is a routine update on continued listing compliance. There are no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb elements to analyze.
